subject.title: refactor(channels): adopt durable Nextcloud Talk and Nostr ingress

question: Should this protected delivery refactor merge after maintainer validation of the two channel-specific upgrade and live recovery paths, or should the durable migrations be narrowed until that proof is available?
rationale: The PR deliberately changes persistent ingress ownership and retry semantics for externally delivered messages; correctness depends on channel-specific runtime behavior that tests and static CI cannot fully establish.

options.title: Validate and merge with live proof
options.body: Review the migration and lifecycle semantics, then require redacted live durable-admission and restart-recovery evidence for Nextcloud Talk and Nostr before landing.

options.title: Split channel migrations
options.body: Land only the channel whose live and upgrade behavior can be demonstrated, keeping the other transport in a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Pause for contract changes
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want different queue ownership, failure, or cursor-progress semantics than the shared ingress contract provides.

recommendation.title: Validate and merge with live proof
recommendation.body: Review the migration and lifecycle semantics, then require redacted live durable-admission and restart-recovery evidence for Nextcloud Talk and Nostr before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR author is also assigned and authored the durable-ingress implementation; independent area ownership history could not be verified.
